title: FIRST-USER:461
text: - Extend representative activation cases beyond the onboard handoff: project setup, meaningful strategy/initiative docs, steering-created work and the first item reaching its actual **done** state. Prove required checks and approvals; merging is sufficient only when the selected completion obligations permit it. Cover new and mature projects, no GitHub, interrupted/resumed onboarding and a second machine. Optional capabilities absent from the selected work must not become setup gates; project facts persist while this machine is checked separately. Use the existing campaign archetypes, not a new exhaustive feature matrix.
